steps.title: Name your game
steps.text: Its name is in the project’s settings. The title screen and an exported game show it.

steps.title: Rewrite what Osric asks
steps.text: A talk is lines and the options under them. Change his request, or add an answer of your own.

steps.title: Change the main quest
steps.text: Each stage is what the journal says and what must be done before the next. The game ends when it’s done.

steps.title: Move the bandits’ camp
steps.text: The green opens in the Scene panel at the bandits’ fire. Drag it, and Brand and Fen, somewhere else, then bake its navigation again.

steps.title: Make the cave’s bandit tougher
steps.text: Gorm’s health and armour are his stats. What he wields is in his hand.

steps.title: Change what Wenna trades
steps.text: She sells from her bag and pays from her purse. Her bench restocks bread each day.

steps.title: Give Wenna’s job another cave
steps.text: Supplies finds the nearest space tagged cave and an object in it tagged cache. Tag another space cave and it can send you there.

steps.title: Recolour it
steps.text: Six colours, a typeface and a size are the whole theme.

steps.title: Play it
steps.text: Play it in the Play panel, then export it from the Project panel.
